text: Motorola user here 👋🏻! Us people don't have a built-in photo gallery, and Google photos is our first reliable go-to. However, it seems to lack a few basic features, such as: 1. flipping a photo without needing to editing it... it's really annoying and time-consuming to edit and then get a new copy of the same photos everytime 🙄. 2. Allow us to invert the order of photos even outside the albums. 3. Can have better editing tools... it's Google we are talking about here: no compromises 😄.

The app is so nice as far..I even purchased storage..but it would be nice if we get the option to enlist faces manually as well because sometimes it doesn't automatically recognise faces of the photo taken either from back , side or in dim light . hence if we can manually add face it would be easier for us to find out photos based on face 🤌

Excellent Photo Management App! Google Photos is one of the most useful apps for safely storing, organizing, and accessing photos and videos. The automatic backup, powerful search, easy sharing, and smart organization features make it extremely convenient. I especially like how easily I can find old photos and memories by date, location, or people. Simple, reliable, and very user-friendly. Highly recommended! 👍📸

Good for photo storage and searching, but it sends too many memories/themed notifications each day and there isn't an option to fine-tune this other than to disable them. I like the occasional one to look back on but the current rate is pestering. Similarly, there's a pop-up (I think about AI editing of something? I dismiss it because I want to 👏 look 👏 at 👏 my 👏 photos when I open the app) that holds up using the app for what it's for. it's gotten pretty irritating to use.

AI search is slower, less accurate, and more presumptuous than the version we had before. When AI search first came out, we even had a choice between the two, no longer. It's forced AI that interests the companies' surveillance more than the customers' choice, and I'll be switching to another storage provider as soon as possible. For work, I'd look up "maps" to pull up maps of locations I service, but the AI assumes I want Google Maps or "map view" and takes over my phone's control to switch.

Their is a lot to like about the photo app. the editing tools are great and very easy to use. The new AI edits are quite impressive. However, facial recognition! This used to work well but has become a complete mess recently to the point it's useless to even try and search by name. Random people in backgrounds are being assigned key family members. It ignores 50% of the people clearly in the foreground. And there is no way to manually assign people to help fix errors, Apart from remove photo.

Used to be a good, March update ruined it. Moved all the editing options. onto different categories, no makes little sense. won't let you re-edit a photo you've already edited. instead makes you revert to original and do all the work again if you want to re-crop or similar. once you then save a copy that becomes almost impossible to find. doesn't get out next to the original or at the top of the gallery like before. only found mine in recently added, which obviously, they are not, Just edited.

I'm not the biggest fan of folders being on a second page, separated from the first page which only shows camera roll photos. And for some reason, I can't delete photos anymore? It just pulls up an infinitely-looping circle of doom and does nothing. Strange stuff. Otherwise, the app has amazing features that I really enjoy. I love that I can order photos through the app. While I haven't used it yet, I certainly plan to! Altogether, I really just use the app became it came pre-installed.

Within the last 48 hours, I've probably uninstalled and reinstalled this apt close to 10 times. When the app finally backs-up photos, it's missing some (photos that are in my albums on my phone aren't showing up in app). Also when I click on a photo in the app, it opens a different picture. I'm thinking to uninstall app entirely. You'd think Google, of all software out there, could get this right!

I've been thinking about writing a review since the change in the way I can edit my own photos, but I thought it'd be fine. It's not. This sucks. Google lens is no longer in the suggested actions at the bottom, instead you have to tap on the three dots in the upper right corner, which is just unnecessary and annoying. The editor is actually trash now, like I'd rather download an extra app to edit/crop my pics and everytime I want to look through my albums it opens the search function.

I HATE the new organization of Collections. Now I have to click through multiple menus to find my folders, it takes longer and I don't want or need it. I also wish I could default to open on my Device folders which is what I use the most. I do not care about Memories. I hate the pop-ups that constantly ask me to back up my photos (which I do not want to do). This app gets worse and worse with every update. At least allow us to customize our default view! Please!!

Your last update is terrible. You removed the blur option which was AMAZING for blurring the background of my photos of flowers. The flowers would just pop with a heavy blur. The portrait blur is not nearly as good, especially when I use blur and depth to get my flowers to look how I want them to. It DOES look good, but when I save it, the blur almost disappears. Your "upgrade" is really a downgrade.

ugh! what have you done to the editing controls!! get rid of the inefficient and inaccurate AI garage and bring back the custom controls that let me rotate and keystone and crop! AI framing isn't even close to correct! and the manual controls are now so limited I can't even select the correct borders or rotate correctly. the old controls were so much better! one click would pretty closely grab the correct outline and then I could tweak. not anymore!!!

This app is practically unusable anymore. The search engine doesn't ever freaking work when trying to find a specific photo, Even on Wi-Fi the page loads slow when trying to find a picture(Or doesn't load at all), It still doesn't have an option to where it can just save all of your photos/videos into albums without having to manually create them again. I'm only giving this 2 stars because it's one of the only ways that I know to backup my device photos without having to use a PC.

Service has steadily declined for years now. Lots of features just completely don't work, for example saving a new frame from a motion photo. They removed the ability to search your photos if they aren't backed up. The cherry on top is recently they added an effect to your memories so that a large number comes in and shows you how many years it's been, unfortunately this new effect has ruined to quality of every single photo it shows. I really don't know how some of this leaves beta.

Another failed update, still no perspective correction and I note that you can no longer select a different frame from motion photos anymore, used to be able to bring up all frames in a line and slide back and forth to select a different one from the one this daft SW wants to use. However the crop tool has been returned to how it was which is a start. might give this a second star if you ever put perspective correction back in! AI just can't figure it out properly.

Editing photos is terrible since the new update. Cropping is incredibly difficult and was far better before. There's not even "rotate frame" when cropping. The edited photo will be small (frankly difficult to see) in the middle surrounded by black then when you hold to compare to original picture that goes full screen (impossible to compare how the look because the propations are so vastly different. The brush that selects parts of the photo pain in the neck now, it should be given it's own tab

the new update makes zero sense, I likes it where I was able to just watch all my albums in one go, instead now it's all folder inside of folder?! I have bad memory and can't always remember if I've backed up a photo already, or if it's still on my device, not to mention now there's a pets and people tab, which you'd think would be nice, but no! I get constant reminders of people I don't want to see anymore with photos I thought were gone! thanks a lot Google, and not in a nice way!

Since the update, I can't choose separate photos for my lock screen wallpaper or main wallpaper. There is only an option for "wallpaper" now, which stretches and distorts the photo to fit the size of the screen! Also in order to continue editing a photo, I have to revert back to the original and edit all over again! Please go back to the original options; why do companies feel the need to constantly change everything every couple months, and not to their users' preference?? So frustrating!

i really don't like this app. i don't like the 'moments' it randomly creates that can't be turned off. i don't like that albums aren't on the same level as the default categories (for example if you take a photo from the downloads category and put it in an album it still exists in the downloads category.) i don't like the facial detection grouping, it rarely works and just adds to the already messy layout. i could say more but i'm running out of characters.

this app used to be perfect, but the quality has gone downhill. the new ai search rarely finds the photos i want in comparison to the old search where i'd find my photos every time. there's also a recent bug where adding photos to an album sometimes creates duplicates, and they are really hard to get rid of. it seems to be related to a delay when pressing the button to add a collection of photos, sometimes this hangs for like 10 seconds and i think if i press it twice i get duplicates.

This app is great but something isn't working with the backup, albums and syncing across devices/platforms at the moment. I created an album on another device and the album didn't show up on this device. I modified photos through this app on another device and the changes didn't move across. I tried to share an album and I was told the picture, which I took last night still needed to be uploaded despite automatic backup on. They should have been uploaded over night ages ago.

They added search to the Add To Album popup! Someone *is* reading all those feedbacks I send!!! Easy backup of photos and videos. Nice interface for browsing photos and videos. Sometimes fails or errors out, but not too bad. Video creator is mostly automatic but I like the amount of tweaking it provides (adjusting music, filter, and titles).

Loved Google Photos. Always demonstrating to people how easy it was to find a photo i.e. 'Dog in a hat'. Now the search has changed to AI and it's terrible. Even changing to classic, the same search will show your photo briefly, then change to 'Nothing found' or a huge list of random garbage. I cannot search anything. So sad. I have thousands of photos in storage. Google was my end all, be all.

It won't let me merge peoples labels or import my photos from Google drive. So after another few years of Google photos and drive, I'm about to give up on this service. It's good, yes. But expensive! The amount of duplicates I have of stuff and photos isn't easely mended either. Now that I'm trying to mend all of that and need to download all my stuff from both photos and drive, it's extremely difficult! For some reason Google hasn't got a select all photos! Google takeout is rubbish too.

AI replacement got rid of the best editing features. the number one thing as an artist that I used was the perspective crop tool, followed by some of the color adjustments. they were quick at the fingertips and matched quality that you'd get from Photoshop. low and behold after an update these features no longer exist, making this app absolutely useless imo. I don't care about access through any Google platform, the editing tools were what made it. so disappointed in all the AI integration.

Why is this update?! So cramming full of AI junk is a reason to remove half the functions of the app? what was wrong with the old one? I now cannot apparently reshape my images properly, most of the use I have for the editing app is reshaping photos I take of my paintings. That is apparently not possible now. The 'AI' auto frame doesn't seem to understand 'square, border images' or have a clue what a user might want from an effort to edit one. Useless.

Change is sometimes difficult. Finding specific photos varies between easy and challenging, depending on both Google's and your interpretation of search words. The latest changes have made it more difficult to find photos by people's names.. Those albums have disappeared from easy view; you have to figure out how to find them.

*Edit -- Feedback left via the app* Everything is pretty good, but please quit asking me if I want to backup all of my photos every other time I open the app. I pay for the app and use it to backup certain photos, and I don't want to backup ALL of my phone's photos...EVER! Not to mention that another pop-up shows up having my photos selected with a big button to backup and only a small button to reject this option.

I would very much appreciate it if the out of storage display (for backed up documents) would stop appearing. My photos are automatically backup without my say so. I'm not interested in having most of my docs backed up. I back them up myself. It would be nice if the user can decide what to have backed up. I'm not interested in paying for more backup storage. I would give five stars if I didn't have that problem. It can be very annoying.

Google Photos is one of the best apps for storing and organizing photos. It automatically backs up your images, offers powerful search features, and groups faces and places accurately. The editing tools are simple yet effective. The cloud storage helps free up space on your phone. Some features now require a subscription, but overall it’s a reliable and smart photo management app.

Horrible app. Having the app downloaded eats over half of your "free 15 GB" of storage. Updates constantly shuffle around your photos on social media camera rolls. This app is further proof that I will not purchase a Google smartphone from here on out. If there's one thing I can't stand in photography, it's apps like these that constantly mess with your ability to organize and share your work. Pay for extra storage? That's your answer. Get real and kick rocks Google.

It was great but in collections it only sometimes let's me merge faces with collections I already have, most of the time it won't pick up the collections I already have there so have to save lots of groupings of the same person in duplicate names. Edit: I mean that with some faces, when I try to merge, it's not picking up that there's already a grouping with their name on so I have many groupings named the same, although other faces it's fine and their name shows on the 'suggested' list.

UI downgrade with latest update. Cropping tools are clunkier and less intuitive. Curved handles on corners are more difficult to use precisely, and some editing tools have been removed. The "dynamic" filter now auto crops and straightens the picture, which is usually what I want to do anyway but not always, and now this tool has an unexpected additional effect. Lots of AI based tools I have little interest in added.

Used to love Google Photos, especially the Perspective tool that let me fix slanted angles and straighten lines. Now it's gone with the new update, and there's no substitute. Please bring it back. This was essential for editing architecture, scanned documents, and travel photos. Until then, 2 stars.

I hate the latest update. please change it back. it takes so long to edit something now because you have to scroll across to access the different sliders and you can only see 2 at a time, so you have no idea how long you'll be scrolling for. Light and Colour options are on different menus and you have to exit one to access the other. I used to use both simultaneously. Who designed this?! Have you purposely made it difficult to use because you'll be releasing a paid version? it's infuriating.

I would give this 5 stars for being easy to use and easy to find my pictures, but it keeps insisting on backing up to the cloud. It seems like every other week it asks me if I want to turn on backup, even though I have repeatedly said no previously, and it defaults to yes, making it easy to accidentally turn backup on and filling up my Google account, as keeps happening with my mom.

Easy to use and much improved over the years! After the oneui 7 update, the widgets have gone a bit weird and the photos don't resize to the size of the widget, if that makes sense. It's now this super narrow horizontal photo, which kind of defeats the purpose of having the photo widget! Is this a google photos issue or a software update issue?

My favorites on my Motorola keep getting removed from that folder for no reason! This is the second time it has happened and as an artist, i use the favorites folder to save my references from my screenshots as a shortcut. It's irritating everytime it happens because then i have to spend an hour diving into the ocean of my almost 4k screenshots to find the reference im looking for. Fix it!!! PS: Please make it to where i can create my own folders, and stop trying to force me to turn on backup!!

Poor usability. Can't select a bunch of photos to move them to an album AND archive at same time. (Photos have to be reselected for subsequent actions.) App insists on labelling my dog as one that died 15 years ago despite them being different colours. Basic editing options such as cropping and straightening are not as quick to access as they should be. Search terms and results are biased towards North American norms.

Extremely aggressive in trying to get me to back up my photos, turned on auto-backup without my knowing, but what's most annoying is when I deleted from google photos to free up space, it also deleted the same items from my phone. I'm mad and disappointed, I want to be able to delete from one while keeping the other. What's the point of a separate storage space if it forces me to have all the same things stored?

I like the photos app, but I really don't like the way Collections has a random Places folder that is the first one in the list. I'm not interested in the grouping of my photos by place or accessing them like this and I should be able to delete or move this collection down the list so the folders I want are near the top.

Within the past couple weeks, I'm unable to use search - all searches return no results. App no longer grabs search terms from the 'commenting' area where I label important photos or screenshots from the past. I've tried force stop, reboot, update, clear cache - no change. Concerned that clear data or uninstalling will cause photo losses. Can anyone please give me my next SAFE steps to resolve this? Thank you.

With the last update or couple, the facial recognition got SO bad. It used to be pretty good, recognizing faces 80% or so of the time. Now within ten pictures of clear faces, it'll recognize 10% or even less. But then I save a photo of a 360p face and it's perfectly recognizable?? Or even a silhouette of a side profile is recognized, yet not a clear face. Please fix the facial recognition. I have so many pictures I'd love to put into folders but just can't.

I am on the fence about this app. The new method of organizing is much less user friendly and seems to have missing files. But recently (5 days ago) it updated and yet, at least once a day when I access photos there's a message at the bottom of the screen stating a new version is available. When I click that supposed update, it takes me to the play store and shows it's already installed. So that's fun. Anymore I feel like all Google products and services have taken a dive.

After using this app for decades, since it was created, I just turned the backup option off aam quitting it! So much frustration with the aggressive storage sales tactics, which keep re-uploading images I removed from my online storage to free space for new ones. That is an idiotic and unprofessional approach to force me into buying additional storage... Well, I now cut you altogether! Mr. Sunday Pichai - you better step your game up before becoming an obsolete company.

Ever since the last update, the app has run incredibly slow and has significantly slowed down my workflow. Additionally, the new editing updates don't give me an option to export to Adobe Photoshop Express (which it did before the update) and the cropping tool is now harder to see margins for cutting. Very disappointed.

I went into the app looking for something to send my sister only to discover that it's missing. Just before that I had asked the app to back up my photos to clear up space and it seems a handful had been erased entirely. I'm pretty irritated and now I'm wondering if this is a one time error or how often this happened previously and I never noticed before. I tried all the stuff the "help" section suggestions and nothing. Can't find those images or an explanation.

You ruined a perfectly great app with your recent 2 updates. Collections? They're albums. Memories (here) useless. I don't need the reminders. You keep trying to find ways to force location and place identification. The 'on this device' ridiculous as all are ON this device. Stop the infinitely micro management.

UPDATED TO 4 STARS I like this app but one thing I wish will be implemented is a private album (like on many android devices) or some sort of other security feature. I don't like the fact that pics I don't want to be seen by others can be so easily accessed. And also when trying to attach pics to MMS it never works.

Great for editing, terrible for sharing now. With the latest updates sharing is now buried 5 levels deep in the settings. I'm all for constant improvement, but sharing has essentially been wrecked by the new way that things are organized. All of the prior conversations I had with friends and family are hidden and a pain to access. Feels like functionality for the app was essentially taken away.

YEARS WORTH OF PHOTOS GONE!! There is NO separation between cloud save and local files. I had years worth of photos, important information, close memories, all wiped, because Google photos attempted to cloud save, didn't have enough cloud save storage, so instead of just leaving cloud save off or keeping the files locally on my device, IT TOOK PRIORITY OVER MY LOCAL GALLERY FILES AND WIPED YEARS WORTH OF DATA. I will never use Google photos again

I just want to crop an image, where has crop gone? I don't want a stupid frame around it. this app gets worse with every update. Going back to Samsung with my next phone, yes there are other apps but Google is too restrictive as a whole, wish I never switched in the first place.

App is broken. It used to work fine until a recent update. When you attach an image to a text message about 60% of the image does not appear in the preview, which makes the preview completely worthless. You have to tap on the image to see it. Lots of other people complaining on Google message boards, but Google seems to be ignoring everyone. I'm looking for a new app.
THANK YOU for the new update! Also, thanks for adding the alert about backing up the locked folder!!

I haven't updated the app for at least a year because every review I read indicates that it has gotten worse. Finally I was forced to do so because no matter what I could not edit photos anymore. Instantly it is worse- a cropped image now no longer magnifies to fit the frame once the crop is made, and the editing tools disappear when you zoom to be able to see the image. Inevitably there will be more downgrades. Something to look forward to while editing.

Can we stop adding unnecessary features no one asked for??? I just noticed there are "Automatic albums" where it also allows you to archive photos after 30 days, while it may be useful in some aspects, it's completely useless. The automatic sorting isn't even correct 90% of the time. I DON'T WANT my photos to be sorted like that in unnecessary albums named "Documents". If you really want to keep this feature, at least make it so we can choose to have it or not!!

This is a terrible app. Yet another example of Google hiding basic functionality and usability from their users, whom Google clearly doesn't care for. Prime example: a photo's details used to be easily available, from a simple menu selection, but aren't any more. And no, the swipe up doesn't bring the details up. Just looking to use my phone, Google!

The latest version of the app doesn't seem to order pictures chronologically by default any more. Instead, a random recent picture that (I suppose) the Google AI considers somehow "most relevant" is placed on top. I don't like this and I would like to kindly ask for at least an config option to switch to a strictly chronological ordering of the pictures.

The widget has no album option. it kind of feels like a major oversight because it seems like the most obvious option, but for some reason you're not really given any control of the photos that go up other than faces and moments. Both of those you don't really have the most control over and are curated for you. It's also strange because they don't even have the second obvious one, Favorites.

I used to love this app. So many options to edit my photos. The Magic tool is amazing. But over the last year or so, more and more often I edit a photo, save it and it ends up with lines across it or half the picture is purple or other ways it's ruined. I've submitted these issues multiple times over the last 6+ months but no one has ever responded about them.

Photos used to be the perfect photos app. it had the best search funding of any app. I used to race iphone users to see how far we could find the same photo and I always won. Now this near perfect search function has been replaced by AI, which not only doesn't return the photos I'm looking for, it actually acts as a stumbling block to me finding them. It's slow and inefficient. Another perfectly good tool ruined in the name of trying to convince us that AI is inevitable.

Not intuitive for digital art, which most of my pictures are. The Memories and Face Recognition and such only pay attention to the (very few) actual photos and thus are not helpful. AI tools are trash. If this app wasn't conveniently synced to my Google account I would uninstall and find something else. Also, make the "folders" button easier to get to, and then STOP MOVING IT AROUND! And stop rearranging the order of the *comic panels* in my *album*.

why would you take away the ability to share multiple photos at once? I had to send 10 separate emails, with one photo attached a piece, because you took the ability to share multiple photos away! Such a stupid change. In response to Google. No you can not. when you click on a single photo now, you get a share button, if you select multiple photos, the share button is no longer there after the update

Even with the latest updates, it would not let you edit or add location to the backup photos. Some of the photos detected the wrong person or pet or face, and again, it would not let you edit with correct categories. There are many little things like that they need to be more detail oriented when they come out with new/update version.

this app worked great until recently. now anytime I crop or edit a picture in anyway, it no longer shows up on my camera, recent photos, or any other album in other apps to post. I thought it was a Facebook issue but as it turns out the photos no longer show up on fb, Lightroom, Vinted, eBay, etc. which is pretty inconvenient if you want to post something. none of the recent updates have fixed this issue. before it was a 5/5 now it's a 3/5 please fix this bug!

just leave it alone already. key moments, sticker suggestions, random photos bigger in the grid, notifications. like, dude, this is a photo gallery. not social media. store the photos, display the photos, and then leave me alone. look, go ahead, try stuff out, whatever. at least give me a toggle so i can turn this nonsense off. you harvest every byte of data from every human life and NONE of it shows that you guys are ruining things? seriously, just stop. it was fine as it was YEARS ago.

It would be really great if we had an option to see "unsorted" photos - photos that are NOT in an album. OR see a label on the photo which states the album it is in (maybe on a toggle). It would also be great if we could choose which albums from our phones auto backup to Google photos!! love google photos, some upgrades would be nice. Or even a tag system where it shows the tag on the photo. Just a way to actually organize photos!! Please.

I have issues uploading pics to an app, if I edit the image at all (for example, I'll take a pic and my phone likes to rotate it the wrong way) I'll rotate the image upright, but if I do that, it wont upload to the app I use for work. My workaround has been to screenshot that image, then for whatever reason, it doesn't care that I edit THAT image. I can crop, mark-up, etc and it'll upload at that point. App is Service Titan (Field).

Google photos has always been an amazing gallery app, especially for the memories and moments. But I can't get over the fact that they made all the music in memories, vocal music and I can't change it back to that instrumental music that had that nostalgic feel of past moment's... Google, please add a feature to the app so we could personalized and set the music to Vocal or Instrumental for memories! Thanks.

App freezes/crashes every time I go into collections. it's nearly completely unusable. I went online to find help and it's an issue other people are having but there's no workable solution and doesn't seem to be widespread enough to hope for a patch. I tried emailing the support email listed in the play store but it isn't monitored anymore because google doesn't care about users on its free services. I have tried everything I can think of but nothing helps.

Since last update, the app messed up with my photos a lot, deleted some of my memories. Is that so hard not to delete photos that I probably have there for a reason? Separate issue, is how much that app relies on ai to create albums and sort out people. All ai features are clearly underdeveloped and forced on a user. I can give an example with the way it sorts people in albums. It considers one person, as different people and doesn't allow to manually insert photos to distinguish the person

I truly hate how pushy the app is when you run out of storage, I have no intention to buy more than I'm paying for now and it keeps telling me how I'm going to lose my photos whenever I open it, there needs to be an option to shut up about that and let me manage in peace. I've been a long time customer and I have been paying for 200 gb for years now. There needs to be an option to turn off the reminder to buy more and I will change my review.

Fix Google Photos, PLZZZZ! It used to be my favorite, GO TO for photos until a few weeks ago. I'm an artist, photographer, and major ADHD - I have come to rely on GP so much it's almost 2nd skin, and saved me so much time & hassle.Now, I can't even find all of my photos, albums, etc. Most 🤬 is not being able to just pull up a photo and attach or insert anywhere. Just spent over 1 hr trying to find a photo I had taken of an order that the seller asked for me to upload a pic. (Still can't)

I used to love Google photos but now thinking of moving to iOS thanks to the latest update that doesn't let you have a 4 across grid anymore. Instead the only options are 3 or 5 across and random photos are massive, disrupting the basic grid and making it difficult to select photos in a chronological order. Just a small change that renders the whole app really annoying to use.

Please put the monthly view back to small thumbnails only. The random large photos are incredibly annoying and you can't see the chronological order clearly. Please!! - You have responded to my review but missed the point of what I am saying, we want small thumbnails in the most zoomed out view, no random large photos inserted in the view, it is so annoying and no one needs it when scrolling through large amounts of photos!

There have been multiple recent updates and there have been many editing options that have been created. They are great options! However once you edit a photo even just a little (like cropping), the photo frequently becomes unavailable for posting in another app. You get a message that the photo is processing and this can take hours. So, essentially you can't edit a photo if you want to use it immediately in some other app, which is of course often the point of editing a photo. 🤦‍♀️🤷‍♀️

Why can I download some stuff and other stuff, no. It'll just say downloading when I click on it but nothing. Sometimes I'll get a notification like 30 minutes later saying unsuccessful but it's completely random. I don't know why, there's no clues. it's annoying as hell. It can be the same batch of videos from the same day of the same thing, same album. Let's say out of 10, only 7 will download. The others are in some weird download purgatory. At least on mobile.

This app continues to get enshitified. In 2026 I thought I could send an album to Google photos without any issues but that's not supported. Instead, I selected each individual image and uploaded them thinking they'd be easy to find under recently uploaded. They were not. They were mixed in with my thousands of other pictures, which I'm obviously not going to look through. I'm just going to use another platform to make an album in the cloud. Crazy Google photos can no longer do that with ease.

The latest forced update has totally ruined the interface and usability. I pay for additional storage and have over 20,000 photos stored, and have always been able to set all thumbnails the same size which is essential to be able to scroll through lots of photos. Now every few rows there is a random photo 6 times the size of the rest. This change is pointless and makes it much harder to find the photo I want. I may need to find another app and pay for storage elsewhere

A year and a half on from my original review complaining about its insistance that I use 'backup' and a few updates later and this app has continued trying to get me to turn on 'backup'. It's well over a dozen times now! I don't want to use Google backup/storage at all so why keep insisting I use it? Once more and I disable the app and use a different one for my photo's!
